content:
When operator orders a DB correction, they want stale errors REMOVED across the whole record set, not just patched in the current state.

Direct quote (2026-04-26): "GG is in pen 4. fix all references to her being in 3, reflect the all along truth that she has been in 4 since day 1 on our farm."

Operational shape:
1. Find every reference (DB sheep record, pen roster, doc text, notes prose)
2. Update each so the record reads as if the error never existed — "all along truth"
3. Do NOT preserve the error as history — it was a data-entry mistake, not a real past state
4. Different from genuine state changes ("moved from Pen 1 to Pen 3") — those ARE history and must be kept
5. Commit message and docs should call out the correction ("CORRECTED from prior assumption") so future readers know

Related same-session cases: removing Sam from Pen 3 (he died in Hurricane Helene, not the 2026-04-02 bulk-cleanup date); fixing broken-tail-twin-ewe-2's bulk-cleanup status_date to the real death date 2026-04-22.

Resolved in manateecreeksheep commits 94035dd + 57170cf, merged via PR-23.
